'''Goodvalor's Little Bivoli''' was a dining establishment that was a part of the [[Goodvalor's]] restaurant chain on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It was opened in [[3963 BBY]] by [[Marn Hierogryph]] using his alias of [[Benegryph Goodvalor]] and his heroic status following the [[Battle of Serroco]].<ref name="KOTOR47">[[Knights of the Old Republic 47|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 47]]</ref>
